artboards.title: Letters · shift armed · key press preview
Galaxy Fold · 60% layout · Ctrl + Alt armed
Galaxy Fold · dark · Fn armed shows the Fn legends
Password field · inline suggestions from Enpass

annotations.text:
Review points
1. Key corner radius: 10 dp here. Current Gboard leans toward pill-shaped keys; say if you want rounder.
2. Space bar shows the layout name (Gboard). iOS leaves it blank.
3. The second symbols page is now the code page ({ } [ ] | \ ~ ` < >), reached from ?123 → { }.

Developer mode (</> in the toolbar)
Adds one strip under the toolbar, above whatever layer is open: Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Shift, arrows, Fn.
Modifiers persist across layer switches and the chip at the top always lists what is armed or locked.
Ctrl+C = tap Ctrl, tap c.  Ctrl+] = tap Ctrl, ?123, { }, ].
Fn + arrows = Home/PgUp/PgDn/End (the small legends). Fn + digits on ?123 = F1–F12.
Holding Ctrl and tapping with another finger also works.

Password managers
Android 11+ inline autofill: when a login field gets focus, the manager set as Preferred service in Android settings (Enpass, Google Password Manager, Bitwarden…) sends its suggestions into the keyboard strip. The keyboard never sees the content; it only hosts the chips the manager draws. Tap a chip and the manager fills the fields.
The manager's own pinned entry (the Enpass tile) opens its picker for manual selection.
The key button opens the sheet: current manager, open it, or change it in Android settings. Android does not let a keyboard pick the manager itself, so the choice lives in system settings and the sheet deep-links there.
In password fields the press preview is off and nothing is learned.

Large screens (Galaxy Fold inner display, tablets, ≥ 600 dp wide)
Standard 60% ANSI layout: 15 units per row, every key visible, shifted symbols printed on top of the digit and punctuation keys.
No separate developer mode needed: modifiers are on the board. Fn legends (top-right) light up while Fn is armed.
Right-most bottom key hides the keyboard; Fn + Space switches language.
Width adapts: the same layout scales from 600 dp to 1000+ dp.
